# messq_auth_check

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq auth check

verify a credential from stdin against an auth-file

### Synopsis

Check whether a credential matches SOME entry of the named auth-file and
exit 0 on match, 1 on mismatch — the yes/no shape deployment jobs want
before they ship a rotated secret. The credential arrives on stdin whole,
one trailing LF/CRLF stripped exactly like `messq auth hash`. A mismatch
always names the usual suspects, including the DLQ nuance: an exact grant
like 'orders' never covers 'orders.dlq', while a trailing 'orders*' does.

```
messq auth check [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  printf '%s' "$NEW_CRED" | messq auth check --auth-file /etc/messq/tokens && echo rotate-ok # noexec: shell pipeline carrying a credential
```

### Options

```
      --auth-file string   token file to verify against (or MESSQ_AUTH_FILE)

```
